The '''Oloss Yvæ''' was a mythological [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[skuir fish]]. According to legend, the Oloss Yvæ was pure [[Color/Legends|white]] and large enough to sink [[Harpoon/Legends|harpoon]] [[Boat/Legends|ships]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
